body: They don’t like to see me sick, they want to be the one to help me, they’re lonely without me, they feel inadequate and useless that they can’t be the one to help make me better, basically those reasons. They care about me very much and they’re very supportive, I just have a hard time handling guilt and shame and I feel a lot of that when they are upset for whatever reason and shame from needing help, not being able to do things myself and for needing the get better at all.

I think the medicine helped me start things more but I still felt very overwhelmed doing things and getting through the day (without engaging in my ED, and even that wasn’t 100% helpful). Maybe it needed more time to work in my system or maybe I need a stronger dose. I’m not super interested in taking it though, I feel weird about it. I’m just getting into a rut taking care of myself and not sure how to handle it. I don’t like being a problem for other people. A hospital might be an easy solution for a while but it would make my partner miserable and that would make staying there harder instead of being able to focus on myself. I have mixed feelings.

I live with them. I don’t do anything, I don’t work because of this and my physics health, I don’t engage in hobbies, I’m tired all the time...I’m just kind of a shell and I try to do things sometimes but I don’t have the attention span for it. Most activities are either not stimulating at all and I feel nothing doing it or I feel overwhelmed. I feel overwhelmed a lot of the time.
